# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 72 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 72

**1** A man said to him: "Tell my brothers to divide my father's possessions with me." He said to him: "Man, who has made me a divider?" He turned to his disciples and said to them: "I am not a divider, am I?"

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- Parallel to Luke 12:13-14; in Luke, Jesus simply refuses; in Thomas, Jesus also turns to the disciples with a rhetorical question
- **ⲡⲱⲣϫ** / *pōrj*: "divider" — one who divides/distributes; also carries the sense of one who creates division
- The rhetorical question to the disciples is unique to Thomas and may suggest irony: Jesus as cosmic unifier refuses the role of material divider
- "Man" (*rōme*) — direct address without title
